title: Preserve SRD equipment grouping semantics for deterministic filters
description:
Combined audit finding from Claude Opus 4.8 and ChatGPT review.

The importer captures leaf equipment records but loses important SRD grouping semantics from equipment tables/lists. This makes several already-emitted deterministic filters and proficiencies unsatisfiable without prose/name heuristics.

Known problems:
- Weapon records lack simple/martial and melee/ranged classification, even though starting-equipment filters request martial melee weapons and class proficiencies refer to Simple weapons and martial weapons.
- Arcane focus, druidic focus, holy symbol, musical instrument, and similar item groups are represented as generic gear/tool records without machine-readable group/subtype tags.
- Starting-equipment filters such as select: "arcane-focus", "druidic-focus", "holy-symbol", and "musical-instrument" cannot enumerate candidates deterministically from the catalog.
- The pack handles armor grouping better than weapons, so weapons/foci/instruments should be brought to that level of resolvability.

Acceptance criteria:
- Preserve SRD equipment grouping headers as generated structured metadata.
- Every generated starting-equipment filter resolves to at least one candidate record unless intentionally documented as deferred.
- Class equipment proficiencies such as Simple weapons and martial weapons can resolve to concrete catalog entries.
- Add importer/audit regression coverage.
- Fixes belong in importer/modeling/resolver/audit code, not hand-edits to generated pack JSON.
close_reason: All three children complete: weapons and focus/symbol/instrument/tool groups tagged with structured metadata, and a resolution audit proves every starting-equipment filter and class proficiency phrase resolves to concrete candidates
